from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-d73122ac.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The three-cell horizontal marker lies on the top edge.
    marker_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 2)
    marker_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[marker_row]) if v != 0]
    marker_left, marker_right = min(marker_cols), max(marker_cols)
    markers = [(marker_row, c, grid[marker_row][c]) for c in marker_cols]

    for r0, c0, color in markers:
        matches = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] == color and not (r == r0 and marker_left <= c <= marker_right)]
        if matches:
            r1, c1 = matches[0]
            for r in range(min(r0, r1), max(r0, r1) + 1):
                out[r][c0] = color
            for c in range(min(c0, c1), max(c0, c1) + 1):
                out[r1][c] = color
        else:
            for r in range(r0, h):
                out[r][c0] = color
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
